overview: The School Committee voted to delay middle school grade configuration changes until 2028 and established sustainability, storage, and health center priorities for the new high school building project.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee entered executive session to discuss strategy regarding Medford Teachers Association litigation.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved the consent agenda, including bills, payroll, and meeting minutes from June 15 and July 10, 2026.

items.title: Introduction of New District Staff
items.summary: Superintendent Galusi introduced Ryan Pike as the Director of Facilities and Katie Doucette as the Managing Director for Before and After School programming.

items.title: Grade Configuration Update
items.summary: Approved delaying the earliest implementation of a proposed 5-8 grade configuration at the middle schools to the 2028-2029 school year to allow for better financial and construction planning.

items.title: MCHSBC Update: Community Partner Storage
items.summary: Voted to exclude dedicated storage space for rental partners from the new high school project to prioritize available square footage for staff and educational needs.

items.title: MCHSBC Update: Teen Health Center
items.summary: Approved maintaining space for a Teen Health Center within the high school planning documents to provide medical and mental health services to students.

items.title: MCHSBC Update: Sustainability and LEED Goals
items.summary: Voted to pursue LEED v4 Silver certification for the high school project while prioritizing net-zero energy goals, high-efficiency HVAC systems, and the use of healthy materials over specific point accumulation.

items.title: Resolution 2026-06
items.summary: Tabled the resolution to the August meeting to allow the committee more time for review.

items.title: Resolution 2026-17: State Graduation Council Report
items.summary: Approved a resolution for the Curriculum and Instruction subcommittee to meet by October 15 to review district alignment with the new statewide graduation framework recommendations.

items.title: Resolution 2026-18: State Delegation Funding
items.summary: Approved a resolution thanking the state delegation for securing $632,000 in funding for theater lighting, interactive whiteboards, robotics curricula, and other school improvements.

items.title: Resolution 2026-19: Support for Students Affected by TPS Terminations
items.summary: Approved a resolution supporting students and staff affected by Temporary Protected Status terminations and directing the district to provide relevant training and maintain privacy standards.

items.title: Facilities Subcommittee Referral
items.summary: Referred the issue of rental storage and equipment sprawl at the McGlynn school to the Facilities Subcommittee for further discussion.
